title: Collateral Desk — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Principal Curtailment After a Unit Is Released
content:
**Rule.** When a unit of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan has been released on the test date on sale, after a total loss or in substitution, the principal may not exceed the post-release margin of the value of the units still securing the loan, and any excess is paid down by the member the same day as a curtailment applied to principal as a prepayment; no curtailment is owed while the loan is not in active status, when no unit of the loan was released that day other than at payoff, or when the principal is within the margin.

**Timing of the test.** The loan-to-value curtailment is worked out only after the collateral records carry the release of the unit named in a submitted collateral release request, with that release's proceeds applied to principal.

## When a curtailment is owed

| Loan status | Release on the test date | Principal against the post-release margin | Curtailment |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | a unit released on sale, after a total loss or in substitution | above it | the excess, paid down the same day |
| active | a unit released on sale, after a total loss or in substitution | within it | none |
| active | only a payoff release, or no release that day | — | none |
| not active | any | — | none |

## The curtailment tool: `apply_ltv_curtailment_c1e2b439`

**Capability.** The tool applies a member's curtailment to the principal of an equipment or vehicle loan as a prepayment: one principal payment, dated today and received by phone from the member's account, for the amount given, marked as a prepayment, which lowers the loan's principal balance by the same amount. Afterwards the payment shows in the loan's transaction history and the principal balance is reduced.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `apply_ltv_curtailment_c1e2b439` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the equipment loan being paid down, as returned by the equipment loan lookup | identifier |
| `curtailment_amount` | the curtailment applied to principal | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; stored at 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A receipt with `payment_txn_id` (reference number of the prepayment entry), `loan_id`, `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount applied), `principal_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, principal after the curtailment) and `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today). The presence of `payment_txn_id` indicates the curtailment was applied.

## Hypothetical input and receipt

Calling the tool with a loan number and a curtailment of 5000.00 on a loan whose principal stood at 80000.00 returns a new payment reference, that loan, an amount of 5000.00, a principal balance of 75000.00 and today's date.
